sentences.text: The genus was named after Øystein Djupedal, a former Norwegian minister who funded the excavation with 1.2 million kroner.
Djupedalia belongs to the family Cryptoclididae.

The fossils are dated to the middle Volgian stage, while the genus lived between 149.2 and 143.1 million years ago during the Tithonian stage; these represent different estimates for the age of the material.
